sections.content:
Be careful to distinguish the noun/adjective form from the manner adverb:
- *a magyar nyelv* (the Hungarian language) vs *magyarul* (in Hungarian)
- *egy angol könyv* (an English book) vs *angolul olvas* (reads in English)
- *rossz nap* (a bad day) vs *rosszul vagyok* (I feel sick)
